At Unipaas, we believe the best way to make innovation thrive is through creating a dynamic and inclusive work environment.

Our team is passionate about building impactful payment solutions, and we’re always looking for talented individuals to join us on this journey.

How to Apply?

Ready to take the next step? To apply, please submit your resume and a cover letter in the form below. We look forward to hearing from you!

Our values

Unipaas manifesto

Customers now expect to be more deeply understood than ever. That means new levels of personalisation at every step of the way.

They want to feel businesses are built for them, even at the most transactional moments: the payment.

For us, payment isn’t just the end of their experience. It’s a journey that relies on trust, simplicity, and convenience.

Where every single interaction counts.

That’s why it’s our mission to create tailored payment experiences powered by unified, managed solutions for businesses.

Unipaas, payment journeys your customers love.

FAQ

Do I have to have a background in payments or financial services to work at Unipaas?

No, this is not required! However, for more senior roles, we do usually select candidates with strong track records in payments and financial services.

What are the steps of the application process?

The interview process steps differ for each position. But generally, it will go something like the following.

After submitting your application, HR will review your CV. If relevant, they will contact you to schedule an initial interview, where you will get a broad introduction to the company and the role. Next, you will interview with the hiring manager, complete a home assignment and/or presentation, and potentially interview with C-levels (depending on the seniority of the position). Reference calls will also be completed to conclude the process, and then you get your contract!

Where are your offices?

Based in London and Tel Aviv, we serve platforms and merchants across the UK, Europe and the US.

What types of companies does Unipaas work for?

We work for vertical SaaS companies. We cover transportation, schools and nurseries, salons, property management, leisure clubs, health, and accounting.

When was Unipaas founded?

Unipaas was founded in 2020 by a team of visionary seasoned payment experts who wanted to offer embedded payments that served all of a business’s needs and weren’t just technically integrated add-ons.
